entries: Binaries in releases on disk screened; other public data researched

Owner instruction 'Do both'. 152 binary par files, 71 pulsars in NANOGrav 15, PPTA DR3, EPTA DR2, IPTA DR2, InPTA DR2: 62 pass a model-level screen in some release, 44 of them never searched; 30 of the 44 need no model translation; 9 blocked everywhere. Web research found no large ready-made new release.
Par files only; nothing prepared, downloaded or searched. Proposal, not an approved list. Release adapters and a T2 translation are not built; PPTA binary TOAs not on disk.
